title: Got to do some VFX Gemini Neon
author: luka06111
selftext:
Hi guys I'm doing some VFX for my game [Surgeborn](https://luka0611.itch.io/surgesuperhero) I've had a lot of it done already but then I saw a post here and the guy helped me a bit I started with astra 6.2 and while it's good. It uses WAY too much usage. Then I went to Neon. Used the same skill that astra did. And these are all shaders there is no mesh nothing. And that's where the good thing is. After it gets one element doing more of it is easy. Most of these are 1 pass. They are not perfect. But already very good in my opinion 

I've been improving my game day by day. And ai is a very big part of it. 

And the thing is there's no workflow pretty much get 1 good VFX as a ref. And keep going further. Do a skill and make sure to say that skill is to a rule nor a wall and to keep improving it it really depends on your type of game so each skill will differ.
